milestones.title: Scope and ownership
milestones.work: Confirm private-team scope, ownership, identity boundary, and open experiments.
milestones.exit: Recorded bounded execution baseline; delegated agent authority; J01/J02 scenarios and data ownership.

milestones.title: Repository ready
milestones.work: Scaffold app/API, isolated Postgres, runtimes, real request contract, local setup, CI.
milestones.exit: Fresh checkout runs; browser reaches API; secrets stay server-side; isolated migrations and tests pass.

milestones.title: Private repository slice
milestones.work: Complete J01/J02 and minimal J04 with real Git clients and two identities.
milestones.exit: Authorized create/clone/push/browse; unauthorized reads/writes denied; timeouts and cleanup verified.

milestones.title: Review and merge foundation
milestones.work: Complete review, check reporting, protected merge, and interruption recovery; start packaging experiment.
milestones.exit: Concurrent and stale-state behavior proven; exact result reconciles after service failure.

milestones.title: Usable private forge
milestones.work: Add SSH, import, fuller browsing, releases, and permission-aware activity.
milestones.exit: Pilot daily workflow works; compatibility limitations and measured performance targets are documented.

milestones.title: Connected workspace
milestones.work: Adopt verified Barkpark capabilities and revision-specific evidence.
milestones.exit: Links preserve both owners' permissions; current/stale verification is clear; scoped agent APIs follow ordinary rules.

milestones.title: Managed lifecycle
milestones.work: Finish Cloud launch, upgrade, restore, export/archive; recovery research starts earlier.
milestones.exit: Clean install, unhealthy-release rejection, real replacement-host restore, supported export and removal.

milestones.title: First complete release
milestones.work: Complete bounded pilot and reconcile all accepted scope, artifact identity, runbooks, and evidence.
milestones.exit: Every required journey has current release-candidate evidence; no blocking correctness gap; agent evaluations pass all evidence gates without human sign-off.

supportTracks.title: Barkpark contract research
supportTracks.note: Proposed early research; verify supported APIs and permissions before adoption at M5. Overlap requires available execution capacity.

supportTracks.title: Packaging + restore research
supportTracks.note: Proposed early experiments for D05/D06/D07; managed lifecycle acceptance still belongs to M6. Overlap requires available execution capacity.

supportTracks.title: Quality + repo maintenance
supportTracks.note: Checks and upkeep at every stage. Live evidence collection and unattended scheduling remain implementation work.
